measurement_caveats: Adaptive analytics metrics are observations/estimates, not billing invoices. Every returned avg.sampleInterval is 1; no sampling multiplier was applied. Confidence intervals were not queried.
Query dimensions expose no sync run ID, caller or stage. Stage association uses query shape, code and supplied completion times; concurrent same-table activity is not independently ruled out.
Three ALTER query errors have zero recorded rows; detailed error strings remain private. No failure incident conclusion is drawn.
No causal savings or currency calculation. changed/total 2003/28456 and 28148/28476 are content churn ratios, not rows billed or costs saved.
The current source was read, not executed; runtime/deployed code identity was outside this sidecar. No search of all historic logs or proof that metadata never existed elsewhere.

persistence_assessment.cloudflare: Relevant historical telemetry already exists and was recovered here; it is not wholly unavailable or waiting for a new collector.
persistence_assessment.inspected_local_code: Current hash and count parsers discard returned cost metadata; import helper keeps overwriteable output but no durable per-stage structured cost record. This conclusion is scoped to inspected call paths.
persistence_assessment.remaining_gap: Exact import per-table/per-statement costs and run/caller identity are not recoverable from this result; missing detail must remain unknown.

subsequent_instrumentation_recommendatio.scope: Recommendation only; parent daily collector remains separate and unchanged. No implementation or extra production requests in this task.
capture_on_next_existing_natural_run: For each existing migration/prefetch/import/verify call, persist run_id, script, code_ref, normalized table/stage/operation, start/end UTC, attempt, success/error class and any returned rows_read, rows_written, duration. Missing fields must be null with reason, not zero.

Preserve every returned statement or import-result metadata item before hash/count parsing or overwrite, keyed to call/bundle/attempt. Keep SQL text, literals and credentials out of shareable records.

For file imports exposing only bundle totals, record scope=import_bundle and all affected table labels; do not assign the entire write metric exclusively to the main table. Per-statement allocation requires execution-result metadata if supported; otherwise keep it unavailable.
Retain attempts separately; do not count retries as unique successful work. Reconcile observed same-window database totals with recorded successful calls while preserving uncertain timeout effects.

Store changed/new/removed/unchanged as content counters separate from physical row-cost counters. A savings claim needs a matched counterfactual with equivalent input/work and accounting for reads, indexes and metadata; this sidecar supplies none.

code_evidence.observation: Hash prefetch paginates; its parser keeps results and drops response cost metadata.
Parser reads only results; no retained per-call rows_read/rows_written ledger.
File import redirects output to a caller path, overwritten per attempt; no structured per-stage cost persistence here.
Uses execute.out for file import; subsequent verification extracts only returned count at line 506.
Same import output handling; subsequent verification extracts only returned count at line 695.
Failure state is removed on success; it is not a per-run cost history.
